description: This Java source file defines the EncounterProvider class, representing the mapping between Encounters and Providers in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It manages relationships and provides copy functionality.

classes.name: EncounterProvider
classes.description: A class representing the association between an Encounter and a Provider, including the role played during the encounter.

methods.name: setEncounterProviderId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this EncounterProvider record.

methods.name: getEncounterProviderId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this EncounterProvider record.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID, delegating to getEncounterProviderId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID, delegating to setEncounterProviderId.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Sets the Encounter object for this record.

methods.name: setProvider
methods.description: Sets the Provider object for this record.

methods.name: getEncounterRole
methods.description: Retrieves the EncounterRole associated with this encounter.

methods.name: setEncounterRole
methods.description: Sets the EncounterRole for this record.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this EncounterProvider with all relevant data copied over.
